label: Bible Study
prompt: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of _____.
verse: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
note: Jesus clearing the temple — quoting Isaiah 56 and Jeremiah 7 as he did it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to _____ you.
verse: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.
note: The priest's pep talk before battle: you're not fighting alone — God goes with you to save you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained _____ in the sight of all them that looked upon her.
verse: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.
note: Esther asked for nothing beyond what the chamberlain advised — and won favour with everyone who saw her.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But as many as received him, to them gave he _____ to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verse: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
note: The prologue's open door: not born into it by blood, but receiving him grants the right to be God's children.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and _____ sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verse: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
note: Isaiah's diagnosis of a sinful nation: wounds, bruises, and 'putrifying sores' — note the KJV spelling — with no one to bind them.
